source: Library of Congress Abraham Lincoln Papers, Shelf Order catalogue

catalogue.selection: 70 consecutive manuscript items after box 1 (positions 2-73), all 257 supplied canvases; whole items added while under 250 pages, box 1's stop rule.
catalogue.canvas_counts: tile.loc.gov image service probed to the first 404; loc.gov manifests are behind a Cloudflare challenge (W46.seg-adapt-lora, 2026-11-04).
catalogue.limits: Consecutive returned catalogue positions establish source selection, not physical gap-free archival arrangement. No completed-transcription filter. Original record fragments and unfilmed sides may exist; no synthetic replacements.

rights: Library of Congress historical collection; images retained locally, metadata/truth/scores only in git.
render: Official IIIF Image API 2.1: full/!2000,2000/0/default.jpg; all supplied canvases, original order, 2000-pixel ceiling, not full-resolution masters.

audit.method: Catalogue starts are document starts. Each within-item gap was read by Gemini 3.7 Flash on the Stanford gateway (two page images, the ten rules, the catalogue title); 'same' is a continuation, and 'new', 'unsure' or a failed reply makes the gap unsure. No Claude or owner reading (W46.seg-adapt-lora).
